name: FLA_ACCOUNTING_LINES
description: FLA_ACCOUNTING_LINES contains accounting transaction lines generated for FLA_ACCOUNTING_HEADERS_ALL.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_LINE_ID
columns.description: Accounting transaction line identifier. It is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_ID
columns.description: Accounting transaction header identifier. This is referenced from FLA_ACCOUNTING_HEADERS_ALL.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Schedule type code like INTEREST_EXPENSE, LEASE_LIABILITY, RESERVE, RIGHT_OF_USE, AMORTIZATION, LEASE_EXPENSE and so forth.

columns.name: LINE_NUM
columns.description: Line number for the accounting transaction line.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description of the transaction line.

columns.name: DR_CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Row identifier in the GL Code Combinations table associated with this distribution. This will be populated if the Lease Accounting Payment Accounts are setup for the Payment.

columns.name: CR_CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Row identifier in the GL Code Combinations table associated with this distribution. This will be populated if the Lease Accounting Payment Accounts are setup for the Payment.

columns.name: DR_ACCOUNT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Account class of the debit account.

columns.name: CR_ACCOUNT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Account class of the credit account.

columns.name: ENTERED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Transaction amount in entered currency.

columns.name: ACCOUNTED_AMOUNT
columns.description: Transaction amount in accounted currency.

columns.name: CONVERSION_RATE
columns.description: Rate used to calculate the functional currency amount.

columns.name: CONVERSION_RATE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Exchange rate type for foreign currency amounts.

columns.name: CONVERSION_DATE
columns.description: Date exchange rate is effective from.

columns.name: APPLIED_TO_LINE_ID
columns.description: Business flow transaction line identifier.

columns.name: PAYMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Payment number. Payment header to which the accounting line belongs to.

columns.name: CURRENCY_CODE
columns.description: Payment currency code as defined in the lease payment.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_HEADER_ID
columns.description: Schedule header identifier. This is referenced from FLA_SCHEDULE_HEADERS table.

columns.name: ACCRUAL_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Accrual schedule identifier. This is referenced from FLA_ACCRUAL_SCHEDULES table.

columns.name: PAYMENT_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Payment item identifier. This is referenced from FLA_PAYMENT_ITEMS table.

columns.name: SOURCE_REFERENCE_ID1
columns.description: Source reference ID identifier 1. Source value could be SCHEDULE_HEADER_ID, PAYMENT_ITEM_ID, ACCRUAL_SCHEDULE_ID.

columns.name: SOURCE_REFERENCE_ID2
columns.description: Source reference ID identifier 2. For future use.

columns.name: SOURCE_REFERENCE_ID3
columns.description: Source reference ID identifier 3. For future use.

columns.name: REVERSED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this transaction is reversed.

columns.name: PARENT_TRANSACTION_LINE_ID
columns.description: Parent transaction Identifier in case this transaction is for a reversal.

columns.name: PREVIOUS_CONVERSION_RATE
columns.description: Previous Rate used to calculate the functional currency amount.

columns.name: PREVIOUS_CONV_RATE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Previous Exchange rate type for foreign currency amounts.

columns.name: PREVIOUS_CONVERSION_DATE
columns.description: Previous Date exchange rate is effective from. Usually the payment due date.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
